In summary, our research is concerned with
the following contributions: (1) a compact posture representation, (2) a robust 3D action recognition method and (3) a 3D action data set.

the following contributions: 1) We present the first 3D action recognition dataset that includes 10 indoor activities, performed by 10 subjects from 4 different viewpoints; 2) we propose a compact representation of human action, HOJ3D, which can be computed from 3D joint location data; 3) we propose a view invariant approach for action recognition, which is based on HOJ3Ds, LDA, HMMs and visual words;
the following contributions: 1) We introduce HOJ3D, a new compact representation of 3D skeletal postures.
